summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration file that sets up a Joomla website with a MariaDB database. It defines two services that will run in containers: a Joomla application server and a MariaDB database server. The configuration uses template variables (marked with %%) that can be customized when the file is used, such as the project name, port number, and database password.

explanations.1: The %% syntax with name= creates a placeholder variable that will be replaced with an actual value (like 'kingsbridge') when this template is processed.
explanations.9: This maps port 8080 on your computer to port 80 inside the Joomla container, so you can access the website by visiting localhost:8080 in your browser.
explanations.11: This tells the Joomla application where to find its database by setting an environment variable to the hostname 'joomladb', which is the name of the other service defined below.
explanations.13: The depends_on clause ensures the database service starts before the Joomla service, since Joomla needs the database to be ready.
explanations.18: This specifies the exact version (11.1.2) of the MariaDB database image to use, rather than just 'latest', ensuring consistent behavior across different setups.
